subject: SableWorks on-prem cluster deployment: node fleet, storage, and ops playbook
messages:
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Mike Turner <mike.turner@sableworks.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SableWorks on-prem cluster deployment: initial playbook and questions

Mike — thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached is a first-draft playbook focused on the parts we discussed: node fleet definitions, storage layout (ephemeral NVMe + network blockstore), CSI considerations, and the ops handoff checklist. Key asks in this message: please confirm rack power zoning, whether the on-site KMS is available for provider integration, and your IP subnet for the Kubernetes pod/service CIDRs.

High-level summary (TL;DR):
- Node pools: 3 node classes (control-plane, gpu-inference, general-purpose compute). We'll use taints/tolerations and runtimeClasses to isolate inference pods.
- Storage: local NVMe on inference nodes as ephemeral KV-cache (tmpfs fallback), persistent data on customer SAN presented via multipath iSCSI + RedHat-style LVM PVs. CSI: we recommend using the vendor CSI + external-provisioner; test with multipath and node-killer scenarios.
- Networking: Calico in policy-only mode with BGP between racks; BGP peering will be optional if you prefer overlay. Need pod CIDR / service CIDR confirmation.
- Ops: Grafana/Prometheus + node exporter + NVMe SMART + NTP/SNMP hooks. Alerting playbooks included.

Attachments: hardware_inventory.xlsx (request you fill missing serials), sable_ip_plan.csv (fill in the IP pools), initial-playbook.md (our draft).

Next steps we propose:
1) You confirm rack-level power zones and whether the site supports bonded 25Gb NIC for GPU nodes (deadline: EOD 2027-07-18).
2) We run a 2-hour ops workshop (remote) to step through CSI multipath failover and KMS keywrap tests (target week of 7/26).
3) On-site acceptance plan with smoke tests (PV attach/detach, eviction under load) during cutover weekend.

If anything in the playbook conflicts with your internal ops policies, flag it inline in the sheet and we'll iterate.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

From: Mike Turner <mike.turner@sableworks.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@sableworks.com>, infra@sableworks.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SableWorks on-prem cluster deployment: initial playbook and questions

Thanks Grace — got the playbook and sheets. A few quick responses:

- Rack power zoning: confirmed, racks A1-A3 are dual-PDU with A/B 20A per rack. We can map GPUs to the A-side PDUs to balance.
- KMS: we have an HSM-backed KMS (Thales) managed by our security team. They require a short integration review but are open to a key-wrapping approach.
- NICs: most racks have dual 25Gb uplinks; we need to confirm a single-rack that has 100Gb. We'll fill that column in the hardware sheet.
- Pod CIDR: we propose 10.32.0.0/12 for pods and 10.96.0.0/12 for services (we'll confirm if that collides with existing L2).

Action items on our side: we'll update the hardware_inventory.xlsx with serials and uplink counts, and Priya will share the exact Thales contact for the KMS integration. Expect our updates by Monday 7/19.

Also one operational note: our SAN team prefers LVM-on-top-of-raw-luns vs passing volumes directly; they'd like us to consider the implications for snapshot workflows and backup chaining.

— Mike
Mike Turner
Director, Infrastructure — SableWorks
mike.turner@sableworks.com
+1 206-555-1212

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Mike Turner <mike.turner@sableworks.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SableWorks on-prem cluster deployment: initial playbook and questions

Mike — super helpful, thanks. I'm looping in Laura (cluster engineering) and Aditya (storage/network ops) for two specific asks below.

1) KMS: Laura — can we plan a short threat-model review with SableWorks' Thales contact before we wire up envelope encryption? We'll need to confirm that key rotation API calls won't impact node restarts during kubelet boot.

2) SAN/LVM approach: Aditya — given SableWorks' preference for LVM-on-LUN, can you run a quick note about tradeoffs in the playbook? Specifically: a) snapshot consistency with CSI snapshots, b) recommended filesystem (ext4 vs xfs) and mount options for db workloads, and c) an ops recipe for recovering a PV when the LUN is re-mapped to a different lun id.

Operational adjustments we made in the attached playbook based on your note:
- Added a fallback: if multipath+iscsi performance < 80% of baseline during soak, we'll provision a small set of NVMe-backed persistent PVs (replicated across nodes) for hot state.
- Added a preflight: verify NTP + SMART + BMC reachability from the management VLAN before any nodepool provisioning.

Can SableWorks confirm whether they have a policy that forbids node-local persistent volumes (we proposed ephemeral-only on NVMe for cache but indicated persistent NVMe as fallback)? If there's a hard ban we can adjust to use network-backed storage only.

Thanks — Grace

--
Laura Bennett (cc)
Senior Cluster Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Aditya Rao (cc)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@sableworks.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: mike.turner@sableworks.com, infra@sableworks.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SableWorks on-prem cluster deployment: initial playbook and questions

Thanks all — quick confirmation from SableWorks side:
- No ban on node-local persistent NVMe, but anything persistent must be encrypted with customer KMS keys. Thales contact is attached; I'll put them on the calendar for next Tuesday.
- We'll use the suggested pod/service CIDRs (10.32.0.0/12, 10.96.0.0/12) — infra team to verify L2 overlap by Monday.
- Hardware sheet: completed columns for uplinks and PDU mapping, left a few serial numbers pending for legacy blades.

We'll book the 30-minute KMS sync (Priya + Thales + Laura + Grace) and the ops workshop for the week of 7/26. I'll update the drive folder with the completed hardware inventory.

Priya
Priya Shah
Infrastructure Program Manager, SableWorks
